free_tier.stated: 5 GB of file storage per team on Free; unlimited on Twist Unlimited. 100 MB per attachment.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

tooling: Twist REST API (api.twist.com/api/v3) with attachment upload by `file_id`; OAuth2 app registration. Weaker client ecosystem than Slack.
chaining: Unlimited free teams per account ('create a separate, free team'), so N teams x 5 GB is trivially repeatable. But each team needs its own members/invites.
limits_note: 5 GB/team; 100 MB/attachment; 10 MB for emailed attachments; free-plan thread history older than one month is not viewable (though Twist explicitly retains it server-side and never deletes).
